name: Light cruiser hull
description: Finer than a heavy cruiser and carrying less belt over the same length.
_waterplaneCoefficientComment: Derived from the profile above; recorded for reference. Warship values sit around 0.70-0.75.
_verticalFullnessComment: Fraction of the waterplane-area x draft prism the submerged hull actually fills. Multiplied by the waterplane coefficient this gives the block coefficient: about 0.59 for a fast battleship, 0.50 for a destroyer.
